## About
Maverick Motors Service is the service side of Maverick Motors at 1651 S Stemmons Fwy in Lewisville. Our service team will treat your vehicle like one of our own, whether it's a routine oil change or a repair you've been putting off.
We handle all repairs and upgrades. That means the everyday stuff like brakes, tune ups and tire rotations, plus lifts, leveling kits, wheels and tires, custom bumpers and leather seats for your truck or SUV.
Drivers around Lewisville give us a 4.5 on Google from 40 reviews. Call, reserve your spot online or come by in person. We welcome you anytime.

## Services
- Full Synthetic Oil Change: Keep your engine happy with a full synthetic oil change.
- Free Brake Inspection: Bring it in and we'll take a look at your brakes at no charge.
- Brake Job: When your brakes need work, we'll take care of it.
- Free Code Scans: Check engine light on? We'll scan the codes for free so you know what you're dealing with.
- Lifts: Lifts and leveling kits for trucks, Jeeps and SUVs. Every lift and leveling package comes with a lifetime warranty.
- Free mounting and balancing: Get a new set of wheels and tires from us and the mounting and balancing is free.
- Custom Bumpers: Custom front and rear bumpers from top name brand companies.
- Leather: Tired of cloth seats? We can turn your seats from cloth to leather.

## FAQ
Q: How do I book a service?
A: Give us a call, reserve your spot online or drop by in person. Whatever's easiest for you.

Q: I sent a service request online. When will I hear back?
A: A service person will reach out within 24 hours of your request.

Q: Can I get my state inspection done here?
A: Yes. Pick State Inspection when you request service, or just call us.

Q: Is there a warranty on lift kits?
A: Yes. All of our lift and leveling packages have a lifetime warranty.
